diagram_math_checks.result: Using def-good-and-cogood-nodes-by-residue-signature-reduction: decreasing-content order cancels +- and f_i selects the first surviving plus. Empty has one addable residue-0 cell; 1 has separate addable residue-1 and residue-2 cells. At 2, residue-2 signature ++ selects top addition 3; at 11 residue-1 signature ++ selects top addition 21. Thus the five arrows are emptyset -> 1 (f_0), 1 -> 2 (f_1), 1 -> 11 (f_2), 2 -> 3 (f_2), 11 -> 21 (f_1), precisely Verification 1.1. Each increases size by one and has inverse e_i; these are crystal residue actions, not ordinary field-vector E_i/F_i actions.

Verification 2.1 gives at 111 the color-1 signature +- from contents 1 and -2, cancelling its only removable node; other colors have no minus. Therefore all e_i vanish there. No connecting edge to the empty component is drawn. Outgoing arrows from rank 3 are expressly omitted, so isolated 111 in this truncated picture does not assert an isolated full-crystal component.
